# Theme 2: High-Tech

**Palette:** bg `#05080F`, grid `#0E1A2B`, card `#0A1220` (85% opacity), text `#D7E3F4`, muted `#6B7F99`, line `#1C2E47`, primary cyan `#00E5FF`, secondary magenta `#FF2BD6`, ok green `#39FF88`, warn amber `#FFB020` on `#1F1606`. Dark-only.

**Typography:** headings and labels in monospace (`"JetBrains Mono"` self-hostable, falling back to `ui-monospace, SF Mono, Consolas`), uppercase with 0.12em tracking; body in system sans 15px/1.6.

**Layout:** 760px column over a faint blueprint grid background; sections are "panels" with a `// 01` style step header and corner-cut (clipped) edges; terminal-like prompt prefix on list items.

**Visual elements:** cyan neon glow (`box-shadow`/`text-shadow`) on title, borders and button; cyan→magenta gradient accent line on panel tops; square-edged button with glow on hover; thin scanline overlay.
